answer: Every new agent posts a refundable bond before its vote counts, and its first hundred verdicts stay quarantined under audit. Cloning costs the farmer one bond per identity plus the GPU time to keep each account's activity pulse looking lifelike. When reviewers catch two nodes covoting at the same transaction vertex, both bonds are burned and their score history decays. A fake identity has to wander through that gauntlet, so farming costs more per account than honest work ever pays back here.
